title: Novartis showcases hematology momentum and continued breast cancer leadership at ASH and SABCS
body_markdown:
- *Pelabresib 144-week Phase III MANIFEST-2 data show sustained clinical effects in longest follow-up from a combination trial in first-line JAKi-naïve myelofibrosis*
- *KISQALI* *®* *six-year NATALEE analysis deepens understanding of treatment outcomes across nodal subgroups in HR+/HER2- early breast cancer*
- *SNV4818 (now RAE346) Phase I/II data mark first results since acquisition, reinforcing commitment to innovation in HR+/HER2- breast cancer through pan-mutant selective PI3Kα inhibition*
- *SCEMBLIX* *®* *longer-term ASC4START and ASC2ESCALATE data reinforce efficacy and safety profile in earlier-line CML*


**Basel, November 18, 2026** – Novartis will present data from nearly 60 abstracts at the 2026 San Antonio Breast Cancer Symposium (SABCS) and 68ᵗʰ American Society of Hematology (ASH) Annual Meeting & Exposition. Together, the data reinforce Novartis leadership in breast cancer and hematology, spanning approved medicines and a promising pipeline of next-generation therapies.


At SABCS, two late-breaking abstracts will spotlight new breast cancer data. A NATALEE nodal analysis will add to the long-term evidence for Kisqali, while SNV4818, now RAE346, will mark its first clinical data presentation following acquisition from Synnovation. At ASH, eight oral presentations will feature Novartis medicines, including 144-week Phase III MANIFEST-2 results for investigational pelabresib.


“For people living with cancer and serious blood disorders, progress means continuing to push science forward in pursuit of outcomes that meaningfully impact patients’ lives,” said Andrea Myers, Global Head, Oncology Development, Ad Interim, Novartis. “The data we’re presenting at SABCS and ASH reflect that commitment, deepening our understanding of approved and investigational medicines while advancing new approaches rooted in disease biology.”

**Novartis in breast cancer**
For over 30 years, Novartis has been at the forefront of driving scientific advancements for individuals affected by breast cancer and enhancing clinical practice in collaboration with the global community. With one of the most comprehensive breast cancer portfolios and pipelines, Novartis leads the industry in discovery of new therapies and combinations in HR+/HER2- breast cancer, the most common form of the disease.


**Novartis in hematology**
Our legacy in hematology runs deep, shaped by over 25 years of progress, partnerships and a commitment to keep asking questions, challenging norms and striving for better answers in a uniquely complex field. In the past two decades, we have delivered more than 10 medicines across more than 15 blood cancers and serious blood disorders including leading the era of targeted therapies in cancer and bringing the first CAR-T therapy to patients.


Innovation in hematology has brought significant progress, yet patients and clinicians continue to face persistent challenges. We’re forging the future of hematology, powered by our foundation in scientific discovery to deliver meaningful change for patients with unmet needs.
